fields.Participants: Records Mgr, Compliance, IT, Department Owners
fields.Trigger: Annual review or new document type

workflows.name: Enterprise Document Taxonomy & Classification Scheme Maintenance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Records Manager maintains enterprise taxonomy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Department Owners validate taxonomy covers their records" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document management system" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Findability risk**: Poor taxonomy hampers retrieval and audit response; mitigated by structured classification scheme
System Touchpoints: - Document management system taxonomy; classification rules

steps.activity: Records Manager maintains enterprise taxonomy: document class (financial, HR, legal, tax, contract, operational), subtype, confidentiality, retention class
Department Owners validate taxonomy covers their records; Records Manager maps each class to retention rule and authoritative system
IT configures taxonomy in document management system; enforces classification at capture

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "Records Custodian captures document in repository" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates against taxonomy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records Custodian declares record" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
- operational: mandatory fields and validation; operational: fields and validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Missing metadata hampers retrieval; mitigated by mandatory fields and validation
System Touchpoints: - Document capture/OCR; metadata tagging; ERP linkage

steps.activity: Records Custodian captures document in repository (scan/email-intake/upload); applies metadata (date, type, counterparty, period, entity)
IT auto-tags via OCR/classification where possible; validates against taxonomy; flags incomplete metadata
Records Custodian declares record status (official copy) where applicable; links to authoritative transaction in ERP

workflows.name: Version Control, Check-Out/In & Authoritative Source Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Document Owner checks out controlled document" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Records Manager maintains version history and supersedence" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Integrity risk**: Multiple conflicting versions; mitigated by check-out/in and authoritative-source designation

steps.activity: Document Owner checks out controlled document; edits; tracks changes; checks in new version
Records Manager maintains version history and supersedence; ensures only current version is active; archives prior versions
Records Manager designates authoritative source for each record class (e.g., ERP invoice is authoritative; PDF copy is reference)

workflows.name: Document Access Control, Permissions & Confidentiality Tiering

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager assigns confidentiality tier" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "logs access to Confidential/Restricted" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews access quarterly" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Over-broad access exposes confidential records; mitigated by tiering and quarterly review
System Touchpoints: - Access control matrix; access logging; quarterly recertification

steps.activity: Records Manager assigns confidentiality tier (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) per document class
IT Security enforces role-based access by tier; manages permissions; logs access to Confidential/Restricted
IT Security/HR reviews access quarterly; revokes on role change/separation; audits access logs for anomalies

fields.Participants: Records Mgr, Store Admin, Off-site Vendor
fields.Trigger: Physical record creation or retrieval request

workflows.name: Physical Records Storage, Barcode & Retrieval Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs to repository with location" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Records Manager coordinates off-site storage for inactive records" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-request of "Records Manager retrieves records on request" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: Mis-filed/mis-placed physical records; mitigated by barcoding and chain-of-custody
System Touchpoints: - Physical records repository; barcode/location tracking; retrieval workflow

steps.activity: Store Admin boxes and barcodes physical records (signed invoices, permits, contracts); logs to repository with location
Records Manager coordinates off-site storage for inactive records; tracks location and retrieval path
Records Manager retrieves records on request; logs retrieval and return; ensures chain-of-custody

workflows.name: Digital Repository Architecture, Search & Records Declaration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise search across metadata and content" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records Manager/Compliance defines records-declaration rules" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
- operational: metadata discipline and access-aware search
Pain Points / Risks: - **Findability risk**: Poor search hampers retrieval; mitigated by metadata discipline and access-aware search
System Touchpoints: - Repository storage tiers; enterprise search; records-declaration engine

steps.activity: IT maintains digital repository architecture (storage tiers, backup, redundancy); ensures scalability for growing volume
IT provides enterprise search across metadata and content (OCR for scans); tunes relevance and access-aware results
Records Manager/Compliance defines records-declaration rules (what constitutes official record); configures in repository

fields.Participants: Tax Tech Lead, IT, Records Manager

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "Tax Tech Lead ensures e-book of accounts" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records Manager retains per BIR 10-year requirement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Non-tamper-evident archive invalidates records at BIR audit; mitigated by integrity controls
System Touchpoints: - Tamper-evident archive; e-book generator; BIR CAS inspection support

steps.activity: IT archives e-invoices/receipts (BIR-compliant format) in tamper-evident repository; links to POS/AR transaction
Tax Tech Lead ensures e-book of accounts (sales/purchases/journal/cash/ledger) archived per BIR format; validates integrity
Records Manager retains per BIR 10-year requirement; supports BIR CAS inspection of e-books and e-invoices

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager runs duplicate detection and metadata-completeness reports" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-classify of "Department Custodians remediate" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports quality score trend to Compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-493 (ensure controlled execution — Document Classification, Versioning & Taxonomy (PA-88.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Duplicate/incomplete records bloat repository and hamper retrieval; mitigated by quarterly cleanup
System Touchpoints: - Quality analytics; deduplication engine; quality scorecard

steps.activity: Records Manager runs duplicate detection and metadata-completeness reports; identifies low-quality records
Department Custodians remediate (merge duplicates, complete metadata, re-classify); records actions
IT tunes deduplication and classification automation; reports quality score trend to Compliance
